symptom: OSPF neighbors between R1 and R2 never reach FULL state; routes are missing.

expected_fault: Area mismatch: R1 advertises the link in area 0 while R2 advertises it in area 1, so OSPF adjacency never forms.

evidence_reference: show ip ospf neighbor is empty on both routers; process numbers differ in the configs shown.
proposed_fix: Match the OSPF process IDs on both routers
reviewer_note: Process IDs are locally significant and don't need to match between routers; the AI cited the wrong OSPF parameter. The area mismatch shown in the running-config is the actual blocker.
